Refitting

Removing

Fit the outer race for the axial and radial bearings and secure it using the bolts.

When fitting a new bearing with a multi-polar magnetic codifier, remove the (black) plastic protection just before fitting the bearing.

The bearing should be fitted with the multipolar magnetic codifier facing towards the A.B.S. sensor

Avoid any impacts to the multipolar magnetic codifier. Avoid any contact between the multipolar magnetic codifer and dirty surfaces. At the end of the fitting operation, check that the multipolar magnetic codifier is clean and, if necessary, clean it using a clean cloth.

Fit the radial bearing track using the hydraulic press, a suitable plate and a suitable fitting tool.

Fit the dust cover on the wheel hub.

Fit the wheel hub complete with bearings and axial bearing track using the hydraulic press, a suitable plate and a suitable fitting tool.
